storylines.summary: A new French customer asks for a quote, orders and confirms the order arrived.
storylines.editorNotes: Formal English; prices in the sent quote only; first order of a new customer.

beats.subject: Request for quotation
beats.body:
Dear Mr Morgan,

We would be grateful for your quotation for 100 bearing units UCP 205 and 200 deep groove ball bearings 6205-2RS, delivered to Grenoble. Kindly indicate your unit prices and the delivery time.

Yours sincerely,
Julien Marchand
Responsable achats
Delacroix Usinage SAS
+33 4 5550 3901

questions: What are your unit prices for 100 UCP 205 and 200 bearings 6205-2RS?

beats.subject: RE: Request for quotation
beats.body:
Dear Mr Marchand,

thank you for your request. Our quotation Q-26-0318:
- 100 x NH-52340 bearing unit UCP 205 at 20.80 EUR = 2,080.00 EUR
- 200 x NH-52300 bearing 6205-2RS at 6.10 EUR = 1,220.00 EUR
Total 3,300.00 EUR net, delivered Grenoble, delivery time 6 working days.

Yours sincerely
Alex Morgan

beats.subject: RE: Request for quotation
beats.body:
Dear Mr Morgan,

Please accept our order DU-26-0098 according to your quotation Q-26-0318.

Yours sincerely,
Julien Marchand

beats.subject: RE: Request for quotation
beats.body:
Dear Mr Marchand,

thank you, your order DU-26-0098 is confirmed as SO-26-0167, 3,300.00 EUR net, delivery in Grenoble on 29 July.

Yours sincerely
Alex Morgan
